description: The line plot illustrates the similarity of HSAs (Hierarchical Softmax Algorithms) across different language pairs within the Qwen1.5-1.8B model, as it progresses through various layers. The x-axis, labeled "Layer," is linear and ranges from 0 to 24, with tick labels at every 2 layers. The y-axis, labeled "Similarity," is also linear, ranging from 0.00 to 0.45, with tick labels at every 0.05 increment. The plot features four lines, each representing a different language pair: 'en&en' (red), 'en&es' (blue), 'en&el' (green), and 'en&bn' (pink). The 'en&en' line starts at approximately 0.07 at layer 0, peaks at layer 6 with a value of 0.26, and then declines steadily to 0.08 at layer 20 before sharply increasing to 0.43 at layer 23. The 'en&es' line begins at 0.06 at layer 0, peaks at layer 6 with a value of 0.24, and then stabilizes around 0.06 from layer 20 onward, showing no significant increase. The 'en&el' and 'en&bn' lines exhibit similar trends, starting at 0.04 and 0.03 respectively, peaking at layer 6 with values of 0.15 and 0.13, and then declining to 0.05 at layer 20 before increasing to 0.3 at layer 23. Notably, the similarity between 'en&es' consistently exceeds that of 'en&en' across layers 6 to 20, contrary to expectations.
